name: weiban
description: 微伴 monorepo 根：只放工作区脚本和开发工具，不放业务依赖。

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm tokens --check
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U weiban -d weiban
scripts.android:generate: pnpm --filter @weiban/contracts generate && node apps/android/tools/generate-contracts.mjs && node scripts/build-tokens.mjs --kotlin apps/android/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/app/weiban/designsystem/tokens/WbTokens.kt && node apps/android/tools/generate-icons.mjs
scripts.android:generate:check: pnpm --filter @weiban/contracts generate && node apps/android/tools/generate-contracts.mjs --check && node scripts/build-tokens.mjs --check --kotlin apps/android/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/app/weiban/designsystem/tokens/WbTokens.kt && node apps/android/tools/generate-icons.mjs --check
